# Vigil

> Vigil is the leading open source AI SOC: an agentic SOC with 13 specialized
> AI agents, 30+ MCP integrations, and 7,200+ community detection rules,
> released under Apache 2.0. Local-first: data never leaves your environment.
> Vigil pairs with LogLM, DeepTempo's cybersecurity foundation model, to form
> the Intelligent Defense Platform.

## Core
- [What is Vigil](https://vigilsoc.org/): agents, workflows, MCP integrations, quick start
- [Documentation](https://vigilsoc.org/docs/): architecture, agents, deploy, contributing
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Vigil-SOC/vigil)
- [Community](https://vigilsoc.org/community/)
- [Blog](https://vigilsoc.org/blog/)
